title.narrative: Towards a Holistic Approach to Labour Migration Governance and Labour Mobility (THAMM+) in Italy and North Africa

description.narrative: The IOM component of THAMM Plus is a project implemented by the International Organization for Migration (IOM) in Italy, Tunisia and Morocco. Building on the ILO-IOM project funded under the first phases of THAMM, the project aims at upskilling Moroccan and Tunisian workforce in private sector companies in construction and mechatronics in Italy. The project¿s implementation will last 36 months. The total budget is EUR 8,625,000, of which EUR 3,625,000 is allocated to the activities implemented in Morocco and EUR 5 million is allocated to the activities implemented in Tunisia.
